name: Airbnb Stays
author: John Jahn
description: Find somewhere to stay without leaving your trip — search Airbnb for your dates, compare prices and ratings, and add the winner to the plan in one tap.

settings.label: OAuth authorize URL
settings.hint: OpenBnB’s authorize endpoint. Pre-filled automatically on a TREK that supports setting defaults; otherwise enter it by hand.

settings.label: OAuth token URL
settings.hint: OpenBnB’s token endpoint. Pre-filled automatically on a TREK that supports setting defaults; otherwise enter it by hand.

settings.label: OAuth client id
settings.hint: Run `npm run register -- <your TREK URL>` once, then paste the client id it prints.

settings.label: OAuth client secret
settings.hint: From the same command. Stored encrypted; never leaves this server.

settings.label: OpenBnB MCP endpoint
settings.hint: Pre-filled for the hosted OpenBnB service. Change only if you run your own.

settings.label: Map tiles
settings.hint: Optional override. Defaults to OpenStreetMap, which needs no key and works with no setup. Point it elsewhere and add that host under Allowed hosts.

settings.label: Map tiles (dark theme)
settings.hint: Optional override used on a dark theme.

settings.label: Map attribution
settings.hint: Optional. Change it if you change the tile source — most providers require their own credit.
